youtube_description: One operator, one price point, wildly different headcount than the venture-backed version of the same business. Full breakdown — the messy revenue numbers, the tool stack, the honest economics — drops Monday at 11:00 ET. [long-form link]
linkedin_post:
One person, reportedly $1-3M a year, $95 a month in tools, zero employees.

A venture-backed competitor sells the identical product with 850 employees and a $15,000/month minimum.

Same category. Wildly different shape.

Monday's episode breaks down the solo subscription design agency: the most-cited case (and why its revenue numbers don't agree with each other), the venture-scale comparison, the real tool stack, and the honest gap between what's copyable and what isn't.

Drops Monday at 11:00 ET.
